issuer: the Åland Police Authority (Ålands polismyndighet), after the driving test at the Vehicle Authority (Fordonsmyndigheten)
note: Read 2026-10-30 in Ålex, the Åland Government's collection of Åland law, in the Driving Licence Act for Åland (körkortslag för Åland, 2015:88, as amended to 2021:29 in the sections read). Åland legislates its own driving licences. § 9 lets a licence for category B be issued to someone who has turned 18; § 29 has the police authority issue the licence once the applicant has passed the test at the Vehicle Authority, which has the cards made; § 31 issues category B licences for 15 years at a time (to the 70th birthday for someone between 60 and 66, five years at a time past 66). The licence fee is the police authority's, whose site answered a bot check today, so the fee is null. The identity card is the ids engine's. Licences of the EEA and of the road traffic conventions' states are recognised for driving (§§ 61 and 62), which is not an exchange list; none is held.

sources.title: Ålands landskapsregering, Ålex, Körkortslag för Åland (2015:88)
sources.said: Körkort får utfärdas för den som har fyllt ... c) 18 år för kategori A2, B, BE, C1 och C1E, ... När sökanden har godkänts i förarexamen utfärdar polismyndigheten körkortet i enlighet med 8 §. ... Fordonsmyndigheten svarar för att körkort tillverkas och levereras till polismyndigheten. ... Körkort i kategori AM 120, AM 121, T, A1, A2, A, B och BE utfärdas för 15 år i sänder.
